name: docs-site
description: Weburz-flavored Nuxt 4 documentation site. @nuxt/content + @nuxt/ui v4 + Tailwind v4, brand colors, optional Umami analytics, content schema, ESLint + Prettier, GitHub Actions QA + Pages deploy.

variables.name: ProjectName
variables.prompt: Project display name (used in titles, headers, hero)

variables.name: ProjectDescription
variables.prompt: One-sentence project description (used in meta tags and hero subtitle)
variables.default: Everything you need to know to use My Project.

variables.name: PackageName
variables.prompt: npm package name for the docs site (private)

variables.name: SiteUrl
variables.prompt: Production URL for the docs site, including https://

variables.name: CodeOwner
variables.prompt: GitHub user for CODEOWNERS and Dependabot assignee (without @)

variables.name: UmamiScriptUrl
variables.prompt: Umami analytics script URL (replace with your Umami instance; the placeholder default is obviously fake)
